Nuestra Historia

Cada sabor cuenta una historia...

La blanca Mérida nace del deseo de ofrecer comida yucateca auténtica, preparada con recetas tradicionales e ingredientes de calidad, para compartir el sabor, la historia y la hospitalidad de Mérida con cada uno de ustedes.

Platillo especial - Cochinita pibil

Nuestro Platillo estrella

La Cochinita Pibil es una deliciosa carne de cerdo seleccionada, marinada pacientemente en un recado rojo de achiote y el toque vibrante de la naranja agria de nuestra tierra. Envuelta en hojas de plátano y cocinada a fuego lento hasta que se deshace al primer contacto, nuestra cochinita honra la tradición milenaria del Pib. Servida con sus inseparables cebollitas moradas curtidas y el picante justo del chile habanero. Es más que una receta, es un legado.

HISTORY

Delicious traditions since 1996

Our first, modest restaurant was founded

Our first, modest restaurant was founded with a simple yet heartfelt vision: to create a welcoming haven where the love for food and the joy of sharing it with others could flourish. From those humble beginnings.

2009

A new restaurant has been established in London

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of a new culinary gem in the heart of London! Our restaurant has now officially opened its doors, bringing a fresh and exciting dining experience to this vibrant city. Nestled in the heart of London.

2019

We got a Michelin star

We are elated to share the incredible news that our restaurant has been awarded a prestigious Michelin star! This coveted accolade is a testament to the dedication of our talented chefs, the passion of our staff, and the support of our valued patrons.

2002

2009

Oscar Numan has started cooking for you

We are thrilled to announce that the culinary maestro, Oscar Numan, has joined our team to craft extraordinary culinary experiences for our guests.

2020

A new restaurant was opened in Paris

We're delighted to announce the grand opening of our brand new restaurant in the heart of Paris! Nestled in this city of culinary wonders,

20023

Established own address delivery

We are thrilled to announce that we have now established our own address delivery service! As part of our ongoing commitment to enhancing your dining experience, we've taken the reins of our delivery process.
